measurementNotes: Only cache misses. Historical samples are reported tool-phase totals (lower bounds on composite tasks); API lint 135.859 is a complete summary duration and root 32.797 bounds a complete task. Budgets include at least 30 seconds above max(1.5 x empirical p95, 2 x largest cold sample), except the unchanged default bucket. Sparse-sample p95 is not a population estimate. Cached replay is excluded.
planningMeasurementNotes: Completed intervals from generator/toolchain completion to the first code-check label include module startup, Git, affected-workspace discovery and optional lint planning. They are upper bounds on a planner command, not direct Turbo timings. The planner cap uses twice the largest completed bound plus the existing 30-second measurement margin, rounded up. Interrupted intervals are excluded.
